t: The Environment Detector is able to receive information from the environment like the current time, the current moon phase, the light level of the block and many more.$(p)For the full documentation please see the $(9)$(l:https://docs.advanced-peripherals.de/peripherals/environment_detector/)official wiki page$(/l)$()!
环境监测仪能够获取来自周围环境的信息，例如当前时间、当前月相、方块所在位置的光照等级等众多数据。$(p)完整说明请参阅$(9)$(l:https://docs.advanced-peripherals.de/peripherals/environment_detector/)官方维基页面$(/l)$()！
Connect your Environment Detector to a computer to make use of it!
将你的环境监测仪连接至计算机即可使用！
